apple.name: Apple
apple.title: Apple introduces iPhone 16 and iPhone 16 Plus
apple.summary: Apple today announced iPhone 16 and iPhone 16 Plus, built from the ground up for Apple Intelligence with the new A18 chip, Camera Control, and 48MP Fusion camera.

google.name: Google
google.title: Introducing Gemini: Google’s Most Capable Multimodal AI Model
google.summary: Gemini is Google's most capable and general model, built from the ground up to be multimodal across text, code, audio, image, and video.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA
nvidia.title: NVIDIA Blackwell Platform Arrives to Power a New Era of Computing
nvidia.summary: Powering a new era of computing, NVIDIA announced the Blackwell platform, enabling organizations everywhere to build and run real-time generative AI at 25x less cost and energy.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.title: Introducing Claude 3.5 Sonnet: Industry-Leading Frontier Intelligence
anthropic.summary: Claude 3.5 Sonnet raises the industry standard for intelligence, operating at twice the speed of Claude 3 Opus with state-of-the-art reasoning and coding benchmarks.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.title: Hello GPT-4o: OpenAI's Flagship Multimodal Model
openai.summary: GPT-4o ('omni') integrates text, vision, and audio reasoning natively into a single neural network, enabling natural human-computer interaction in real time.

meta.name: Meta
meta.title: Open Source AI Is the Path Forward: Announcing Llama 3.1
meta.summary: Mark Zuckerberg outlines why open source AI is essential for global technological advancement, releasing Llama 3.1 405B for open enterprise research and development.

microsoft.name: Microsoft
microsoft.title: Introducing Copilot+ PCs: High-Performance Windows AI Hardware
microsoft.summary: Microsoft announces Copilot+ PCs with breakthrough 40+ TOPS silicon, system-wide AI acceleration, and all-day battery life for modern enterprise engineering.

intel.name: Intel
intel.title: Six in 10 Leaders Bet Big on Enterprise Robotics and AI Silicon
intel.summary: Senior business and IT leaders, robotics engineers, and enterprise architects expect their organizations to operate automated AI systems within the next three years.

dawn.name: Dawn Sci-Tech
dawn.title: Apple debuts passport-shaped foldable phone, called Duo
dawn.summary: Apple unveiled a passport-shaped foldable phone called the Duo, marking the tech giant's first foray into foldable smartphones alongside next-generation AI silicon.

propakistani.name: ProPakistani
propakistani.title: iPhone Duo Launches as Apple’s First-Ever Foldable Smartphone
propakistani.summary: Apple officially announced the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone, featuring an innovative dual-hinge design and next-generation A19 Pro chip.

brecorder.name: Business Recorder
brecorder.title: Apple joins foldable phone race with $1,999 passport-shaped iPhone Duo
brecorder.summary: Apple has joined the competitive foldable smartphone landscape, launching the passport-proportioned iPhone Duo starting at $1,999 with on-device generative intelligence.

tribune.name: The Express Tribune
tribune.title: Google to invest $15 billion in AI infrastructure and clean power
tribune.summary: Google plans to invest $15 billion into expanding European artificial intelligence data centers, securing direct long-term clean power to fuel sovereign enterprise AI computing.
